name: kev-pulse
description: Watches for newly released Tenable plugins and newly added CISA KEV entries, correlates them, and can launch guardrailed Tenable scans (TVM or TSC) scoped by dynamic tags.

tio_access_key.title: TVM Access Key
tio_access_key.description: Tenable Vulnerability Management API access key. Leave blank if you only use Security Center.

tio_secret_key.title: TVM Secret Key
tio_secret_key.description: Tenable Vulnerability Management API secret key. Leave blank if you only use Security Center.

tsc_url.title: Security Center URL
tsc_url.description: Your Tenable Security Center hostname, e.g. https://tsc.yourcompany.com. Leave blank if you only use TVM.

tsc_username.title: Security Center Username
tsc_username.description: Tenable Security Center account username. Leave blank if you only use TVM.

tsc_password.title: Security Center Password
tsc_password.description: Tenable Security Center account password. Leave blank if you only use TVM.

primary_backend.title: Primary backend (optional)
primary_backend.description: Which backend the autonomous scan loop uses. Leave blank to auto-detect from whichever credentials above are filled in -- only set this if you fill in BOTH TVM and Security Center and want to choose which one the autonomous loop targets. Values: tvm or sc.
